title: Tank Buster Enchantment
description: Tired of tanky players? Use this enchantment and no more tanky players!
body:
## Pierce Through Everything

Heavily armored enemies can turn combat into a slow, frustrating slog. Netherite-clad mobs and players soak up hit after hit while your damage barely makes a dent, making armor feel less like a fair challenge and more like an annoying damage sponge.

Tank Buster cuts straight through armor with true damage that ignores defense entirely. The heavier the armor, the more this enchantment matters — turning a 13-hit slog into a decisive 5-hit takedown.

## Features
✔ Vanilla-friendly — no new items, just a powerful enchantment that fits naturally into your combat loadout

✔ Lightweight — minimal performance overhead, safe for long-running worlds

✔ Multiplayer-ready — fully server-side compatible, balanced for PvP and PvE alike

## How to Obtain
Find Tank Buster at the enchanting table, or trade with a villager for a guaranteed enchanted book. Combine books at the anvil to reach level 5 for maximum armor penetration.

## Compatibility
Fabric
Singleplayers & Multiplayers
